_README: Model registry. VERIFY EVERY model string against your own account before spending:
model ids change, and which ones you can reach depends on your access.
The runner refuses an id it was not given here, and refuses a key that is not set,
so a stale entry fails before the first paid call rather than halfway through a run.
provider: "anthropic" uses the SDK. "openai" speaks the chat-completions shape over
HTTP and works against any host that serves it, which is how Meta's Llama models are
reached (Meta publishes no first-party API). Point base_url at whoever serves them.
json_mode applies to the openai shape only and is OFF on purpose. Turning it on for
some entries makes arm C's locator more reliable for those entries for a reason that
has nothing to do with the gate. If you enable it, enable it nowhere else or say so.
No sampling parameters are sent to anyone. See the header of providers.js.

gpt._verify: OpenAI's docs recommend GPT-6 Astra for production API use but do not print the id string on that page. Confirm in the model catalog; 'chat-latest' is an alias that moves under you and is a poor choice for a repeat-run experiment.

llama._verify: Served by Groq, not Meta. The newest Llama generation listed there at the time of writing. Confirm tool/function calling is supported for the id you pick: without it, arms A and B cannot run and only arm C is measurable.
